title: Akmen-Meo
summary: Akmen-Meo is a cat-like Hecto-Titan whose hindquarters have decayed down to the bone. She wears a pharaoh's nemes upon her head.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Akmen-Meo is used by [[Whitmont]], a member of the evil [[the Organization|Organization]]. {{Source|TCG:OAL-030|OAL-030}}

Akmen-Meo's ability to sift through ancient texts has impressed the bookish [[Tersly]]. of the [[Huntik Foundation]], who has expressed the wish of having her in the library with him. {{source|TCG:SAS-077|SAS-077}}
